latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Product Video Cutter, a skill for trimming and exporting product video clips for e-commerce marketers.

- Upload product videos (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and cut them into shareable clips.
- Automatic cloud GPU processing with 1080p MP4 output; typical jobs finish in 20–40 seconds.
- Simple onboarding with automatic connection and free token generation (100 free credits valid 7 days).
- User prompts route to upload, export, credits, state, or editing actions via intent classification.
- Supports quick, batch, and iterative editing workflows with persistent session timelines.
- Comprehensive error handling and clear feedback for common upload and export issues.
